verdict.rationale: Twenty offers quick cloud signup ("spin up a workspace in under a minute"), CSV/XLSX import with field mapping and duplicate detection, and fast custom-object/pipeline creation—supporting a rapid, self-serve setup. However, a hands-on community report explicitly says setup was 'extremely easy' but the product was 'pretty alpha-version' with several issues that ultimately made it not work for their use case, undercutting a clean under-an-hour, no-partner-needed experience.
